PACKET 15 - BLIND IMAGE READING (unverified)

Exposure statement: nothing in my context revealed a proposed identification or earlier reading of this text. Reading is from the images only.
Beyond the rules: I made grayscale, autocontrast-enhanced copies of tiles 002-007 and 009-012, plus rotated, enlarged crops of the vertical marginal notes on page 2. They are in .../scratchpad/work/zoom15/. I listed the packet directory to get the image filenames and pixel sizes. Nothing else was opened.
All 14 images loaded.

----------------------------------------------------------------
LAYOUT SURVEY (observations)
----------------------------------------------------------------
Two pages, each with an overview and six overlapping native-resolution tiles:
- Page A = image-001 (overview). Tiles: 002 top-left, 003 top-right, 004 mid-left, 005 mid-right, 006 bottom-left, 007 bottom-right.
- Page B = image-008 (overview). Tiles: 009 top-left, 010 top-right, 011 mid-left, 012 mid-right, 013 bottom-left, 014 bottom-right.

Both pages are upright and in two columns, with about 31-33 lines per column. The script is a small book hand in brown ink, and abbreviation is heavy (nota for "et", "-b;" for "-bus", suspension strokes).
- Page A: modern foliation "25" at top right. The top of the page is badly faded and abraded, along with the upper half of column b and much of column a. A red-ink library stamp, mostly faded, sits in the lower left margin. Small "d"-like marks and dots appear in the left margin beside some lines (006 lines 1-2, 004 lines 1 and 9). In column a there is a slightly larger rubric-style heading "DE NOIB(US)" (004 line 10), and lines 3, 7 and 11 open with enlarged "O" initials. No colour survives on any initial.
- Page B: two vertical marginal notes in a darker, later-looking hand, one in the left margin and one in the intercolumn space. The lower margin and the bottom lines are damaged and stained in both columns (013/014 lower third). The text inside the paragraphs is marked off with section cues such as "In AR.", "In AS.", "In ES.", "In IS.", plus capital "O(mn)ia" openings. No enlarged initials.
- Tentative interpretation (not identification): continuous prose on noun gender arranged by word ending ("Omnia nomina in -X desinentia ... generis sunt, ut ..., exceptis ..."). Main text only. I see no lemma/commentary split. The marginal notes on page B look like later additions.

Selected spans: Page B col a (tiles 009+011) and col b (010+012) in full where legible. Page A: col a heading region and lower lines (004, 006), col b lower half (007).
Left unread or largely unread: page A top lines of both columns (002, 003; faded/abraded), page A col b middle (005; very faint), page B bottom lines of both columns (013, 014; stained/damaged). A raking-light or UV image of page A, and of the bottom of page B, would help.

Conventions: (xx) = my expansion; ? after a word = uncertain reading; [illegible] = not readable; "(et)" = tironian nota. Line numbers are counted from the top of the named tile. Overlap between tiles is noted where it occurs.
